statement.description: React + USWDS front end, FastAPI API and PostgreSQL/PostGIS data layer for USACE enterprise project visibility (migration demo from Oracle APEX). Web application only.
statement.standard: Revised Section 508 (36 CFR Part 1194) and WCAG 2.1 Level AA
statement.evaluation_methods: Automated: axe-core via @axe-core/playwright in CI (every route x 4 viewports x 2 themes x reduced-motion on/off), eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y strict, Lighthouse CI accessibility category (budget 100), pa11y-ci (axe runner, WCAG2AA), Playwright keyboard-traversal and 320 px reflow smoke tests. Manual: keyboard-only pass, NVDA + Firefox, JAWS + Chrome, VoiceOver iOS + Safari, 200% and 400% zoom / 320 CSS px reflow, Windows High Contrast (forced-colors), colour-vision deficiency simulation, prefers-reduced-motion. Manual test IDs (MT-*) refer to docs/a11y/MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md.
known_issues: 39 of 48 WCAG 2.1 A/AA criteria are not evaluated: manual attestation outstanding, no claim made.
228 axe needs-review items (incomplete checks such as contrast over images) await a human decision.
10 of 10 manual test environments are planned and not yet executed.
statement.legal_disclaimer: This report reflects testing of the EVS demo build at the stated version, commit and date and is provided in good faith. Rows marked not-evaluated make no conformance claim. It does not represent a legally binding guarantee.
statement.demo_notice: EVS is a demonstration system. This read-out describes the demo build, not a production deployment.
